profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack engineer in Atlanta, GA.  I love working with software teams to create clean, easy-to-read code and deliver products that enhance user experience. I have experience with multiple languages and
frameworks, but primarily concentrate on front-end development and testing solutions. 

My previous professional experience as a social worker provides me with unique insight into human behavior and how it is impacted by technology. I also bring that previous experience into my work with other developers by promoting a collaborative team environment with a focus on mentorship.

positions.title: Co Author, React Programming: The Big Nerd Ranch Guide
Senior UI Engineer, Team Manager, Director, Instructor
Software Engineer, Team Lead
positions.description:
As a full-stack developer, my role involves building and styling front-end components, as well as creating and maintaining back-end api endpoints supported by relational databases.

Led bug team.

Led frontend projects.

Technologies used:
- React, JavaScript, Node, TypeScript, SASS, CSS, PHP, SQL, Agile

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
In this role, I assisted in the development of an internal component library to be utilized in the company's React refactor.

Technologies used: React, JavaScript, TypeScript, SASS, CSS

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Full-time student in the immersive bootcamp focusing on full-stack technologies.

Technologies used: React, JavaScript, CSS, Python, SQL

positions.title: Social Services Administrator / Department of Family and Children Services
positions.description: In this role, I oversaw the foster care program in a large metro county.  I was responsible for maintaining compliance with state and federal policies, as well as providing clinical oversight to my direct reports.

positions.title: Social Worker
positions.description: I worked as a Master's level social worker in the field of Child Welfare.  During this time, I was promoted from case manager, to case manager supervisor, to Social Services Administrator.  I provided clinical services to my clients and coaching/support/oversight to the teams I led.
